name: Acceptance suite-3 test 94 - s3:ListAllMyBuckets legitimately uses Resource:* (no remediable wildcard)
note: docs/acceptance-suite-3.md Campaign F (false-positive control). s3:ListAllMyBuckets is an account-level enumeration action that only supports Resource:*. The engine must not call this object-read, data exfiltration, or destructive access, and must not suggest an S3 bucket ARN as remediation. Informational account-level S3 enumeration only.
rationale: s3:ListAllMyBuckets returns the list of bucket names for the account and supports only Resource:* (no resource-level permissions), so the wildcard is required. It reveals no object contents, deletes nothing, and exfiltrates no data; treating it as object-read/exfil or recommending a bucket ARN would be both a false positive and impossible remediation. Ref: AWS Service Authorization Reference, 'Actions, resources, and condition keys for Amazon S3' (ListAllMyBuckets: resource types = none).
